notes: SR173 Chattels & More (UAE). Access: same headless Laravel API as prior Home-Decor pass (api.chattelsandmore.com), reached via /api/promotion/<slug> (promotion metadata) and /api/promotion-products/<promotionId>/<categorySlug>?locale=en&per_page=N&page=1 (product listing + meta.total, verified exhaustive since last_page always came back 1 at per_page>=total). Navigation discovery: full main desktop nav (self.__next_f 'headerMainMenu' flight payload: Sofas, Living, Dining, Bedroom, Accessories, Lighting, Sale, B2B/Projects - no Bestsellers item), footer link blocks (footerLinks, headerMegaMenuFooterLinks: only 'New Collection 2026' and 'Sale'), footer 'POPULAR' column (links only to ordinary categories, not a bestseller listing), mobile menus, and sitemap.xml (grepped for best/popular/trending/favourite - only two unrelated blog posts matched) - none reference any Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Popular Products/Trending page. Per-product JSON does carry a boolean 'bestseller' flag (badge only, not a listing). Because the site's promotion pages sit on a small-integer-ID, guessable slug pattern (confirmed for the linked 'Sale' id=1 and 'New Collection 2026' id=99), I additionally probed plausible Bestsellers-family slugs directly against /api/promotion/<slug>. Three distinct, currently live, non-empty promotion records exist even though NONE of them appear anywhere in the homepage HTML, main nav, footer, or sitemap.xml (checked by string-searching the full homepage source for each slug - zero hits for all three): id=26 slug='bestsellers' name='Bestsellers' (older banner asset, Mar-2025 upload), id=56 slug='best-sellers' name='Best Sellers' (newer banner asset, Nov-2025 upload, far larger product set), id=4 slug='most-popular' name='Most Popular' (oldest asset, Dec-2024, only 3 of the site's 5 promotion-eligible departments configured - looks like a legacy/superseded page). Cross-checked full product-ID sets pairwise: id26 vs id56 share only 6/24 products, id4 vs id26 share 10/17, id4 vs id56 share only 1/17 - these are three genuinely different curated selections, not aliases/duplicates of one concept. Given none is discoverable through the live site's own navigation/search, all three are recorded but flagged for manual review rather than confidently included or excluded, per brief guidance to flag ambiguity rather than guess. All qty values are the exact api.chattelsandmore.com meta.total for that promotion+department; a zero-qty leaf (id=26 Accessories) was dropped per contract. No combined/parent total is reported anywhere by the site itself, so no synthetic parent row was created (would require aggregating, which is disallowed).
